name: std::linear_congruential_engine

declarations.code:
template <

    class UIntType,

    UIntType a,

    UIntType c,

    UIntType m

    >
class linear_congruential_engine;

intro: linear_congruential_engine is a random number engine based on Linear congruential generator (LCG).

sections.title: Template parameters
sections.text:
UIntType

 -

 The result type generated by the generator. The effect is undefined if this is not one of unsigned short, unsigned int, unsigned long, or unsigned long long.


 a

 -

 the multiplier term


 c

 -

 the increment term


 m

 -

 the modulus term

When m is not zero, if a >= m or c >= m is true, the program is ill-formed.

sections.title: Generator properties
sections.text:
The size of the states of linear_congruential_engine is 1, each of them consists of a single integer.

The actual modulus \(\scriptsize m_0\)m0 is defined as follows:

If m is not zero, \(\scriptsize m_0\)m0 is m.
 If m is zero, \(\scriptsize m_0\)m0 is the value of std::numeric_limits<result_type>::max() plus 1 (which means \(\scriptsize m_0\)m0 need not be representable as result_type).

The transition algorithm of linear_congruential_engine is \(\scriptsize TA(x_i) = (a \cdot x_i + c)\mod m_0\)TA(xi) = (a·xi+c) mod m0.

The generation algorithm of linear_congruential_engine is \(\scriptsize GA(x_i) = (a \cdot x_i + c)\mod m_0\)GA(xi) = (a·xi+c) mod m0.

The pseudo-random number generated with the current state is also the successor state.

sections.title: Predefined specializations
sections.text:
The following specializations define the random number engine with two commonly used parameter sets:

                                48271, 0, 2147483647>
